track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 25: Gharacheh
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Gharacheh in Rast-Panjgah, Shur. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on A4 and dwells most on A in Gharacheh. The line peaks at Bk4 (478.8 Hz) at 0:16.2. It closes on the tonic (A3 → A2 → A2 → A2 → A3 → A3).
